# precise PR compilation producing delta summaries

Compiles a single pull request and produces a deterministic summary of added, changed, and removed entities. The test asserts counts (added/changed/removed) and that PR-scoped entities (e.g. pull-request/101) are created while out-of-scope entities remain untouched.
